diff --git a/tests/test_env_loader.py b/tests/test_env_loader.py
index 2e85a00..83a9fe6 100644
--- a/tests/test_env_loader.py
+++ b/tests/test_env_loader.py
@@ -505,3 +505,161 @@ def test_filtering_unknown_variables_with_prefix():
     assert not settings.get("IGNOREME")
     # Smoke test.
     assert settings.get("MYCONFIG") == "ham"
+
+
+_BOOLEAN_ENV_CASES = (
+    ("True", True),
+    ("False", False),
+    ("true", True),
+    ("false", False),
+    ('"True"', "True"),
+    ('"False"', "False"),
+    ("@str True", "True"),
+    ("@str False", "False"),
+    ('["True", "False"]', ["True", "False"]),
+    ('{on="True", off="False"}', {"on": "True", "off": "False"}),
+)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("raw, expected", _BOOLEAN_ENV_CASES)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("key", [None, "VALUE"])
+def test_uppercase_boolean_envvars_are_cast_to_bool(
+    monkeypatch, tmp_path, raw, expected, key
+):
+    from dynaconf import Dynaconf
+
+    for name in tuple(os.environ):
+        monkeypatch.delenv(name)
+    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
+    settings_obj = Dynaconf(
+        envvar_prefix="BOOLCAST", settings_files=[], load_dotenv=False
+    )
+    # Initialize before setting the variable so only the explicit load reads it.
+    settings_obj.set("VALUE", None)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("BOOLCAST_VALUE", raw)
+    load_from_env(
+        obj=settings_obj,
+        prefix="BOOLCAST",
+        key=key,
+        silent=False,
+        identifier="env_global",
+        env=False,
+    )
+    value = settings_obj.get("VALUE")
+    if isinstance(expected, bool):
+        assert value is expected
+    else:
+        assert value == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("raw, expected", _BOOLEAN_ENV_CASES)
+def test_uppercase_boolean_envvars_work_through_settings_get(
+    monkeypatch, tmp_path, raw, expected
+):
+    from dynaconf import default_settings
+    from dynaconf import Dynaconf
+
+    for name in tuple(os.environ):
+        monkeypatch.delenv(name)
+    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("DIRECT_BOOL", raw)
+    # Read before a Settings instance has initialized any loaders.
+    early_value = default_settings.get("DIRECT_BOOL")
+    settings_obj = Dynaconf(settings_files=[], load_dotenv=False)
+    fallback_value = settings_obj.get("DIRECT_BOOL", sysenv_fallback=True)
+    for value in (early_value, fallback_value):
+        if isinstance(expected, bool):
+            assert value is expected
+        else:
+            assert value == expected
+
+
+def test_uppercase_boolean_envvars_work_with_default_dynaconf_prefix(
+    monkeypatch,
+):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("DYNACONF_THING", "True")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("DYNACONF_SWITCH", "False")
+    from dynaconf import Dynaconf
+
+    settings_obj = Dynaconf()
+    assert settings_obj.THING is True
+    assert settings_obj.SWITCH is False
+
+
+def test_lowercase_boolean_envvars_still_cast_to_bool(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("BOOLLOWER_ON", "true")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("BOOLLOWER_OFF", "false")
+    loaded = {}
+    load_from_env(
+        obj=loaded,
+        prefix="BOOLLOWER",
+        key=None,
+        silent=True,
+        identifier="env_global",
+        env=False,
+    )
+    assert loaded["ON"] is True
+    assert loaded["OFF"] is False
+
+
+def test_uppercase_boolean_strings_inside_envvar_toml_structures_remain_strings(
+    monkeypatch,
+):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("BOOLSTRUCT_FLAGS", '["True", "False"]')
+    monkeypatch.setenv("BOOLSTRUCT_OPTIONS", '{on="True", off="False"}')
+    loaded = {}
+    load_from_env(
+        obj=loaded,
+        prefix="BOOLSTRUCT",
+        key=None,
+        silent=True,
+        identifier="env_global",
+        env=False,
+    )
+    assert loaded["FLAGS"][0] == "True"
+    assert isinstance(loaded["FLAGS"][0], str)
+    assert loaded["FLAGS"][1] == "False"
+    assert isinstance(loaded["FLAGS"][1], str)
+    assert loaded["OPTIONS"]["on"] == "True"
+    assert isinstance(loaded["OPTIONS"]["on"], str)
+    assert loaded["OPTIONS"]["off"] == "False"
+    assert isinstance(loaded["OPTIONS"]["off"], str)
+
+
+def test_toml_file_quoted_uppercase_booleans_remain_strings(tmp_path):
+    settings_file = tmp_path / "typed_values.toml"
+    settings_file.write_text(
+        'file_true_word = "True"\n'
+        'file_false_word = "False"\n'
+        "file_true_bool = true\n"
+        "file_false_bool = false\n"
+    )
+    from dynaconf import Dynaconf
+
+    settings_obj = Dynaconf(settings_file=str(settings_file))
+    assert settings_obj.FILE_TRUE_WORD == "True"
+    assert isinstance(settings_obj.FILE_TRUE_WORD, str)
+    assert settings_obj.FILE_FALSE_WORD == "False"
+    assert isinstance(settings_obj.FILE_FALSE_WORD, str)
+    assert settings_obj.FILE_TRUE_BOOL is True
+    assert settings_obj.FILE_FALSE_BOOL is False
+
+
+def test_envvar_explicit_string_preservation_for_uppercase_boolean_words(
+    monkeypatch,
+):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("BOOLSTRING_AS_STRING", "@str True")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("BOOLSTRING_QUOTED", '"False"')
+    loaded = {}
+    load_from_env(
+        obj=loaded,
+        prefix="BOOLSTRING",
+        key=None,
+        silent=True,
+        identifier="env_global",
+        env=False,
+    )
+    assert loaded["AS_STRING"] == "True"
+    assert isinstance(loaded["AS_STRING"], str)
+    assert loaded["QUOTED"] == "False"
+    assert isinstance(loaded["QUOTED"], str)

@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+#!/bin/bash
+set -uo pipefail
+cd /testbed
+
+case "${1:-}" in
+  base)
+    python -m pytest tests/test_env_loader.py tests/test_utils.py -v \
+      --deselect=tests/test_env_loader.py::test_uppercase_boolean_envvars_are_cast_to_bool \
+      --deselect=tests/test_env_loader.py::test_uppercase_boolean_envvars_work_through_settings_get \
+      --deselect=tests/test_env_loader.py::test_uppercase_boolean_envvars_work_with_default_dynaconf_prefix \
+      --deselect=tests/test_env_loader.py::test_lowercase_boolean_envvars_still_cast_to_bool \
+      --deselect=tests/test_env_loader.py::test_uppercase_boolean_strings_inside_envvar_toml_structures_remain_strings \
+      --deselect=tests/test_env_loader.py::test_toml_file_quoted_uppercase_booleans_remain_strings \
+      --deselect=tests/test_env_loader.py::test_envvar_explicit_string_preservation_for_uppercase_boolean_words
+    ;;
+  new)
+    python -m pytest \
+      tests/test_env_loader.py::test_uppercase_boolean_envvars_are_cast_to_bool \
+      tests/test_env_loader.py::test_uppercase_boolean_envvars_work_through_settings_get \
+      tests/test_env_loader.py::test_uppercase_boolean_envvars_work_with_default_dynaconf_prefix \
+      tests/test_env_loader.py::test_lowercase_boolean_envvars_still_cast_to_bool \
+      tests/test_env_loader.py::test_uppercase_boolean_strings_inside_envvar_toml_structures_remain_strings \
+      tests/test_env_loader.py::test_toml_file_quoted_uppercase_booleans_remain_strings \
+      tests/test_env_loader.py::test_envvar_explicit_string_preservation_for_uppercase_boolean_words \
+      -v
+    ;;
+  *)
+    echo "usage: $0 base|new"
+    exit 2
+    ;;
+esac

rationale: Extend the existing selected boolean environment tests to cover explicit single-key loading and the early/default environment read in addition to bulk and settings fallback reads. Require real bare True/False booleans while preserving the instruction's lowercase, quoted, @str and embedded TOML string controls. Initialize each real Settings object before the explicit loader read and isolate environment and settings files per case.

inputs.semantic_rationale: Instruction lines 9-11 require bare True/False and lowercase true/false to load as Python booleans; lines 12-14 preserve quoted and @str strings and strings embedded in TOML arrays/tables. Lines 18-20 require supported environment-loading paths without dictating a parser implementation. The original tests covered bulk env loading and sysenv fallback but not key='VALUE' or default_settings.get before instance initialization. Both newly covered reads use the same instruction-supported value matrix. Boolean assertions use identity, not truthiness; structural equality rejects conversion of embedded strings. No new value syntax or TOML-file semantics are introduced.
intended_regression_behaviors: Both load_from_env(key=None) and load_from_env(key='VALUE') return actual booleans for bare True and False.
default_settings.get reads bare True and False correctly before a new Settings instance initializes loaders.
Settings.get(sysenv_fallback=True) continues to produce real booleans for both bare spellings.
Lowercase true/false remain booleans; quoted and @str values remain strings; TOML array/table string leaves remain strings on every expanded path.
Every parameterized case clears and restores process environment, uses a fresh real Settings object, disables settings files/dotenv, and works in its own tmp_path.
inputs.normal_runner_inclusion: Only the bodies/decorators of two existing named selected tests and their shared case matrix change. Existing base deselection and new selection commands remain byte-identical.

supporting_api_evidence.binding: Public upstream API-supporting evidence only, not exact-runtime proof. The admitted setup resolves its base inside the image; the package does not expose that upstream base SHA. No image or solution was opened or executed.

inputs.qualification: static only; no native oracle or retained-shortcut trial executed
